MR-SPF3.6K-LP1-TL20E is a high-performance 3.6kW hybrid solar inverter designed for reliable home and small office power backup in Bangladesh. This advanced inverter combines solar power, battery storage, and grid input to deliver uninterrupted, energy-efficient performance. With pure sine wave output, high MPPT efficiency, and smart battery management, it ensures maximum solar utilization and stable power for sensitive electronics.


Ideal for households facing regular load shedding, the MR-SPF3.6K-LP1-TL20E supports up to 5000W solar input, automatic switching, fast battery charging, and intelligent protection features. Its lightweight design, built-in LCD display, and WiFi monitoring option make it a perfect choice for modern solar energy systems in Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • 3.6kW Pure Sine Wave Output - Ensures stable electricity for appliances, computers, TVs, routers, lights, and more.
  • High-Efficiency MPPT Solar Charger - Supports up to 5000W PV input with wide MPPT voltage range (40–450V DC) for maximum solar energy utilization.
  • Hybrid Operation (Solar + Grid + Battery) - Works with solar panels, utility grid, and batteries to ensure uninterrupted power.
  • 24V Battery System Compatible - Supports both lead-acid and lithium batteries, giving users complete battery flexibility.
  • Fast Switching Technology - Automatically switches between solar, battery, and grid with 10–20ms transfer time, ideal for sensitive electronics.
  • Multiple Charging Modes - Solar charging, AC charging, and hybrid charging available with up to 100A charging current.
  • Smart Monitoring & BMS Support - Equipped with RS485 / CAN communication, mobile app monitoring support, and dry contact options.
  • Compact & Lightweight Design - Sleek and wall-mountable design suitable for homes, offices, and commercial spaces.
